cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Three more departments to cover! My influence is spreading. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no extra budget. You'll have to borrow their meeting rooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Excellent. I'll have a presence in every department.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll find a trolley for your files. We need your desk for the new receptionist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A mobile headquarters! Put the department names on it; they'll see how far my jurisdiction extends.

mechanism: A celebrates loss of resources as expanding jurisdiction while adapting a claimed leadership system to B room and desk constraints so support continues.
confusable: Unlike generic optimism, every burden must mean more influence specifically; borrowed authority quietly accommodates the people providing diminishing resources.
comparison: Department coverage and mobile files differ from a hotel investigation and complaint correspondence from laundry.
seedUse: Use D68-a extra departments/no budget/trolley/desk with S02-a claiming practical concessions as an expanding plan.
